title: Articles: a/an, the, zero article
summary: Choose a/an, the or no article depending on whether something is general, new or specific.

explanation.en: Use a/an for one non-specific countable thing, the for something specific or already known, and no article for many general plural or uncountable meanings.
explanation.ru: A/an используется с одним неспецифичным исчисляемым предметом, the — с конкретным или уже известным, нулевой артикль — во многих общих значениях.

forms.label: A / an
forms.pattern: a + consonant sound · an + vowel sound

forms.label: Zero article
forms.pattern: plural/uncountable noun in a general meaning

commonMistakes.note: Choose a/an by sound: university begins with /j/.
For music in general, no article is normally used.
